parameters.content:
## Error Handler

Set this workflow as the **Error Workflow** on your other workflows:
Workflow → Settings → Error Workflow → pick this one.

It does NOT need to be published. n8n calls it directly when a run fails.

**Important limit:** an Error Trigger only fires when an execution *fails*. A workflow that never triggered at all produces no execution, so there is nothing to fail and this will stay silent. Use the Heartbeat Watchdog template for that case.

nodes.notes: Enable this instead of Slack if you prefer

parameters.content:
### Pick one channel

Slack is enabled, Telegram is disabled. Enable whichever you use and delete the other.

The Telegram node is set to HTML parse mode on purpose — MarkdownV2 requires escaping a long list of characters, and error messages contain most of them.
